card.name: Stray digits and odd characters in numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits such as 6 or 7 inside or at the start of numeric strings, and odd accented or broken characters, in dose tables, enzyme names and codes.

modes.label: Digit in numbers
modes.description: The digit 6 or 7 sits inside a dose, table value or code.

modes.label: Odd characters
modes.description: A stray accented or broken character appears in the middle of a word or symbol list.
